title: Alien reproduction vehicle pilot and pilot manager at Edwards
summary: Steven Greer tells of Alien reproduction vehicle pilot and pilot manager at Edwards, about unspecified at Edwards Air Force Base, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We have a whistleblower who's flown uh an alien reproduction vehicle, a UFO that we've seen. And more importantly, the man who managed all the pilots who flew them out of Edwards Air Force Base Edwards complex.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who gathers testimony from UFO whistleblowers, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025 that he has a whistleblower who has flown an "alien reproduction vehicle," a human-built copy of a UFO. More importantly, Greer says, he also has the man who managed all the pilots who flew these craft out of the Edwards Air Force Base complex in California. If true, it would mean military pilots were regularly flying copied alien craft.
